summary: T7-03 passes. All five story checks exit 0 when I run them. The layout, banners, footer, navigation, the main-scoped page-check and the single client component match the criteria in the code. I did not measure the gzip -9 size of the initial JS myself, because the permission rules forbid the pipe or redirect it needs. I only saw the raw size of the six scripts on `/` (578,302 B). The 177,190 B figure comes from the author's notes.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, eslint and tsc all pass; exit 0. The turbo tasks were cache hits.
pytest 404 passed; web 232 passed, including site-layout.test.tsx (30), mode-banner.test.tsx (14) and page-check.test.ts (15); schema 157 passed. The web and schema turbo tasks were cache hits.
The route table shows ○ / as static. `export const dynamic = 'error'` is in app/page.tsx:8.
web-smoke: GET / (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer.

checks.criterion: Mode banner wording: null mode shows "not chosen (G0 <status>)"; A, B and C show "Shipping mode: <mode>" plus the PRD 4 title; the mock banner appears iff mock=true
checks.evidence: mode-banner.tsx:10-21 defines MODE_TITLES and appends them after " — ". mock-banner.tsx:10 returns null when shellText(...).mockBanner is null. The mode-banner tests pass, and the smoke output shows the null-mode line with G0 NOT_RUN. I did not re-read the PRD 4 wording against MODE_TITLES myself. The test file is said to check it against PRD.md.

checks.criterion: Root layout on every route: skip link, red mock banner with role="status", mode banner, header navigation, main landmark, footer with the bundle and schema version
checks.evidence: layout.tsx:28-38 renders them in that order. mock-banner.tsx uses role="status" and its text states that it is a mock. site-footer.tsx renders "Bundle version: … · Schema …".

checks.criterion: Navigation: seven plain next/link items, no links to /api/docs, /paper, /probe or /compare
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx:11-19 lists exactly Home, Moon, Mars, Earth, Model, Methods and Data with the required hrefs.

checks.criterion: Navigation is keyboard-operable in DOM order, with a visible focus ring and aria-current on the active route
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx:32 sets aria-current="page" on an exact pathname match. The links are plain anchors in an ul. The focus ring is the global :focus-visible outline from T7-01 (per the header comment and the progress notes). I did not run a browser. The author reports a browser Tab-order and client-navigation check.

checks.criterion: Mode C and Mode B wording rules; `/` keeps its three T0 texts and adds only one factual line with no numbers, targets or claims
checks.evidence: page.tsx:13-14 renders only the title and "These pages show records from the bundle named in the footer.". The mode titles are the PRD wording.

checks.criterion: page-check.ts: the "only these texts" assertion applies to <main>; the mock banner, mode line and footer are still asserted; no other check is weakened; the mock-in-production guard is untouched
checks.evidence: The page-check.ts diff keeps the mock banner, shipping-mode, footer and mock-guard checks, and adds a rule that "Shipping mode:" appears at most once. It requires exactly one <main> whose text equals the title plus HOME_LINE. The diff does not touch the mock-in-production guard. I did not read page-check.test.ts or markup.ts, but all 15 page-check tests pass.

checks.criterion: The only new client component is site-header.tsx; the layout and the other components are server components; no provider and no NuqsAdapter
checks.evidence: 'use client' appears only in site-header.tsx:1. The layout adds no provider. site-layout.test.tsx is said to fail on any other 'use client' file in app/ or components/.

checks.criterion: Initial JS on `/` stays within the 250 kB budget, measured with gzip -9 against the 173,974 B baseline and recorded in the notes
checks.command: wc -c on the six scripts in apps/web/.next/server/app/index.html
checks.evidence: I could not run the gzip -9 measurement without a pipe or redirect. The raw total is 578,302 B, so it proves nothing about the gzip size. The author's notes record 177,190 B (+3,216 B), within 250 kB. That is an author claim that I did not reproduce.

findings.claim: The initial-JS measurement (177,190 B gzip -9) rests on the author's notes only; I did not reproduce it.
findings.evidence: The raw sizes of the six scripts on / sum to 578,302 B. The gzip total was not reproducible under the review's permission rules.

findings.claim: Next's default 404 page, shown for the routes that do not exist yet, is dark in dark-mode browsers inside this layout. No link is marked current there.
findings.evidence: This is already recorded in the author's progress notes as a proposed follow-up (an app/not-found.tsx in a later story). The criteria allow these routes to 404.
